categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Sports Games
categories.content: Sports game simulates the playing of real-world sports including sports such as football, badminton and basketball.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Legal
categories.content: Legal industry handles subjective disputes that cannot be solved by smart contracts.

categories.name: Pump Science Ecosystem
categories.content: Pump Science Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pump.science.

categories.name: TimeFi
categories.content: TimeFi is a blockchain-based approach to treating time as a monetizable asset through tokenized productivity, verifiable commitments, and AI-driven incentives.

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Solana Token-2022
categories.content: Solana Token-2022 is a new token standard on Solana that provides additional fungible and non-fungible token functionality.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Metagovernance
categories.content: Metagovernance refers to projects or protocols that primarily hold DAO tokens and actively participates in the governance process of those DAOs.

categories.name: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Product (ETPs)
categories.content: The Tokenized Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs) category includes cryptoassets that represent on-chain versions of traditional Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs). ETPs are traditional financial securities that track underlying securities, an index, or other financial products.

categories.name: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
categories.content: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) refers to digital representation of exchange-traded funds such as SPY, GLD, TQQQ, XLK, VXUS on a blockchain platform.
